text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
"Big sis Creeeeek, I'm huuuungry~. 
Waaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There, there, please don't cry~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna give you something really nice♪ 
C'mon, hold out your hands. Okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
What I wanted to see. Ever since long 
ago... there has only been one thing.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, even if we pick up the pace a 
bit... *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's all so that... I can see what I 
want to see the most.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Phew, worked up a good sweat~. Thank you 
very much for today as well.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, things are going smoothly. 
At this rate, if I can make it from the 
Sumire Stakes into the Classics...
choice_data_list: Creek, can I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, what is it?

Curious, I asked about it. About the 
"thing she wants to see most" that Super 
Creek had mentioned.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, that topic? Uhh-umm...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: How many sweets would you like, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, here are some sweets. How many would 
you like?
choice_data_list: I don't really feel like eating it, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Aww~. Geez, if only you'd just tell me 
honestly.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's how I used to ask them back 
in the day. The children, that is.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"My family runs a daycare, so I often help 
take care of the children together with my 
mother."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
When I asked, "How many sweets do you 
want?" everyone started shouting out all 
kinds of answers at once.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The shy kids say 'just one.' The greedy 
ones say 'tons!'

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's answers were different. But 
there was one thing they all had in 
common.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That would be... seeing how everyone 
smiles when they receive sweets.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That made me truly, truly happy♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Sometimes I think that a smile might just 
be the 'most important thing of all.'"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There are all kinds of children at the 
daycare. Those who are blessed, and those 
who are not.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Still, when people are laughing, everyone 
is happy! If you can make them laugh, in 
that very moment, anyone can be."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I... cannot become everyone's mother. I 
cannot erase all their sadness. However...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just for a brief moment, if I 
can make it the happiest time ever, I want 
to do everything I can.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"So for the sake of seeing their smiles, I 
can push through no matter how tough it 
gets."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So if possible, I'd like you to be 
honest with me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Sweets... If you don't give them the exact 
amount they want, they won't be able to 
smile, after all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"And with that said, Trainer, how many 
would you like?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just be honest about how many times you 
can smile♪ Surely there's no reason you 
wouldn't want to, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, just one? I do like thoughtful girls, 
but I feel like that's not quite it...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We'd definitely want at least that much, 
wouldn't we? But won't just one in April 
and one in May be insufficient?
One in April and one in May...?

A thought crosses my mind. Could this 
actually not be about sweets, but about 
the race...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Please tell me how many you really, truly 
want. Trainer, how many?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very well said. That's right, you 
want three of them, don't you?♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I feel the exact same way. Because this 
big sister wants to give you three of them 
too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, you're not an older sister~. I 
just unconsciously felt like I was back at 
daycare.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. After all, a Trainer is a 
Trainer, aren't they?

We looked at each other and laughed. We 
had a pretty good idea of what kind of 
sweets they were.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer-san. Three. You promised, 
remember?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I can't give it to you right now, but... 
definitely later.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I have some business to attend 
to, so please excuse me.

Having said that, Super Creek headed back 
toward the academy... I wonder what she 
had to do?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa..., I can still keep going. 
Just a little bit more...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
To win all three, I still need to get much 
stronger. The Satsuki Sho, the Derby, the 
Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There's only one thing I want to see. And 
to see it...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I definitely... definitely want to see it 
this autumn... Trainer-san's... smile!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... *cough*...
